newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets FinMin O/N sell and buy tender.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets FinMin O/N sell and buy tender.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Monday set an overnight sell and buy tender for the Finance Ministry with a limit rate of 18.2 percent.
The CNB set the deadline for bids in the operation for 0745 GMT and said two bids would be accepted at a minimum of 100 million crowns each.
In the Finance Ministry's last sell and buy tender on Friday -- a two-week operation -- the limit rate was 18.5 percent.

The operations, on which neither the CNB nor the Finance Ministry have commented, are believed to be performed with the aim of providing short term financing for the Finance Ministry which has been short of funds due to borrowing limits.
